title: fortcraft+
description: Enjoy This amazing Create + TACZ Forge 1.20.1 modpack combining automation, tactical combat, physics, storage upgrades, exploration tools, multiplayer features, visual improvements, and more for both Survival and Creative gameplay.
body:
This modpack combines Create’s creative engineering with TACZ’s tactical combat for a fun experience built for both Survival and Creative mode.

Build advanced factories, design moving machines with Valkyrien Skies, organize resources using Sophisticated Backpacks, explore with Xaero’s Maps, travel quickly through Waystones, and communicate using Simple Voice Chat.

Enhanced visuals, quality-of-life improvements, smoother progression systems, and many more carefully selected mods expand Minecraft while keeping Create and TACZ at the center of the experience.

Whether you want to design massive mechanical creations in Creative or survive, explore, automate, and fight in Survival, this pack gives you the tools to build, experiment, and play your way.
